headline: World Bank Report Highlights Corruption Pressures on Kenyan Mid-Sized Firms
summary: A new World Bank report revealed that 48% of mid-sized businesses in Kenya face demands for bribes, which chokes company operations and stalls economic growth.
why: Regulatory friction and corruption create operational bottlenecks for small and medium enterprises, dampening private sector productivity and economic expansion.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Widespread corruption demands hinder business performance and economic growth.
